scope.workflowBoundary: The qualified slice reads the current Company/branch/department-scoped lead pipeline rows and opportunity stage/value facts used by the retained Sales CRM pipeline list. Accounts, contacts, activities, follow-ups, lead detail source collections and every CRM command remain retained.
scope.domain: CRM read actor policy (commerce.read, CRM module with empty modules treated as all, selected-context expiry), exact Company and optional branch/department scope, bounded search/stage/cursor input, exact pipeline row shape, date/currency/status/stage/opportunity/version coherence, strict descending page keys, a scope-bound opaque cursor, and per-currency forecast totals with per-row integer weighting semantics.
scope.application: One crm_pipeline use case requires the current actor and package history entitlement before any owner read, validates query/cursor scope before the source read, validates every owner row against the actor Company and selected scope, resolves owner/customer labels through public ports after the bounded page read, validates the bounded forecast and derives the next cursor only from the 30-row page plus one overflow row.
scope.adapters: Read-only SQL over CRM-owned crm_leads and crm_opportunities only. The caller's serializable Holding transaction is required. Owner and customer labels are not read from other owners' tables; they arrive through public People and Finance directory ports supplied by composition. No lead, opportunity, activity, account, contact or cross-owner row is created, revised or deleted.
scope.http: Owner-local GET /api/v1/holdings/{holding_slug}/crm/leads?q=&stage=&cursor=. Exact Host/Holding targets, exact HTTPS origin validation, strict query keys and duplicate rejection, bounded search/stage/cursor validation, private/no-store and no-referrer responses, and bounded BusinessError status mapping. The composition backend receives transport facts only and must supply the normal Account session, current Company scope, package admission and serializable owner read.
scope.transport: ERPX_NATIVE_CRM_PIPELINE_CONFIG is strictly validated: loopback-only private base, reserved ports 3000/3001/3100/3101/3103/8080 plus 5432/5433/5435 and 3200-3299 excluded, exact HTTPS Holding origins, unique hosts/slugs, 250..30000 ms timeout, bounded cookie/context/workspace headers, exact row/forecast/purchase/context shapes, unique ordered IDs, scope/stage validation and a 2 MiB response bound. A configured failure never falls back to the retained reader.
scope.ssr: SalesPipelineView uses the native page when ERPX_NATIVE_CRM_PIPELINE_CONFIG is present. An unset configuration retains crmWorkspace and the existing in-memory filter/pagination. Once configured, an invalid or failed native list is surfaced rather than silently replaced. The new-lead form still uses the retained crmWorkspace option read and retained CRM command path.
scope.purchaseAndIdentity: The native application requires the current sales.crm history entitlement through a public Commercial port when enforcement is enabled and serializes the current newWork/settleExisting/history/revision controls. This is a read projection; the composition backend must repeat current authority and purchase admission on its own serializable owner transaction.
